items.q: Benny Goodman and Lester Young had a battle of music that we played Honeysuckle Rose for 45 minutes... They opened with Prez

ctx.x: They would sit in. Benny Goodman and Lester Young had a battle of music that we played Honeysuckle Rose for 45 minutes and in the interchange, Lester played his clarinet and Benny played his tenor and music hadn't been going for 45 minutes at that period of time.
